question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:**

The abbey walls displayed an ancient **paten** of silver.

options.text: The monk placed the Eucharist on the paten.
The art historian dated the paten to the 9th century.
The tailor cut a circular paten from wool fabric.
The relic was enclosed beneath the gold paten.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"paten"** refers to a flat metal or gold dish, typically used in religious ceremonies to hold the bread or Eucharist. (पात्र, विशेष रूप से धार्मिक समारोहों में उपयोग किया जाने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The monk placed the Eucharist on the golden paten during the service.
 
 
 
• The homonym **"pattern"** refers to a repeated decorative design or a template used as a guide for creating something. (डिजाइन या नमूना)
 
 
• **Example:** The tailor cut a circular pattern from wool fabric for the coat.
 
 
 
• In the sentence provided, the word "paten" is confused with "pattern" in Option 3, where the context refers to a tailor cutting a circular design. Hence, this sentence contains the homonym of the highlighted word.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.
